problem.paragraph: Let $$A = \begin{bmatrix} 1 & 0 & 2 \\ 2 & 1 & 6 \\ - 3 & 0 & 5 \end{bmatrix} and B = \begin{bmatrix} 4 & 3 & 2 & 7 \\ 2 & - 9 & 3 & - 4 \end{bmatrix} .$$
Let $$C = \begin{bmatrix} 2 & 3 & 8 & 3 \\ 4 & 1 & 4 & - 1 \\ - 3 & 0 & 5 & 7 \end{bmatrix} and D = \begin{bmatrix} 4 & 6 & 2 \\ 2 & - 9 & 3 \end{bmatrix} .$$
Represent a $$3 \times 2$$ matrix $$C$$ using appropriate letters with subscripts as its entries.
Represent a $$2 \times 4$$ matrix $$A$$ using appropriate letters with subscripts as its entries.
For the matrix $$A$$ in Exercise 1, write out the vectors $$\mathbf{a}_{1}$$ , $$\mathbf{a}_{2}$$ , and $$\mathbf{a}_{3}$$ representing the columns of $$A$$ .
For the matrix $$C$$ in Exercise 2, write out the vectors $$\mathbf{c}_{1}$$ , $$\mathbf{c}_{2}$$ , $$\mathbf{c}_{3}$$ , and $$\mathbf{c}_{4}$$ representing the columns of $$C$$ .

If the vectors $$\mathbf{a}_{1} = \begin{bmatrix} 1 \\ 3 \\ 1 \end{bmatrix}$$ , $$\mathbf{a}_{2} = \begin{bmatrix} 5 \\ 3 \\ {- 1} \end{bmatrix}$$ , and $$\mathbf{a}_{3} = \begin{bmatrix} 0 \\ 2 \\ 0 \end{bmatrix}$$ represent the columns of a matrix $$A$$ , write out the matrix $$A$$ .

If the vectors $$\mathbf{b}_{1} = \begin{bmatrix} {- 1} \\ 2 \\ 4 \end{bmatrix}$$ , $$\mathbf{b}_{2} = \begin{bmatrix} 2 \\ {- 3} \\ 1 \end{bmatrix}$$ , $$\mathbf{b}_{3} = \begin{bmatrix} {- 5} \\ 3 \\ {- 1} \end{bmatrix}$$ , and $$\mathbf{b}_{4} = \begin{bmatrix} 2 \\ {- 2} \\ 0 \end{bmatrix}$$ represent the columns of a matrix $$B$$ , write out the matrix $$B$$ .
Write out a $$3 \times 3$$ diagonal matrix $$D$$ , listing zeros where appropriate and representing entries that can be any real number with appropriate letters and subscripts.
Write out a $$4 \times 4$$ upper triangular matrix $$U$$ , listing zeros where appropriate and representing entries that can be any real number with appropriate letters and subscripts.

list.item: Describe the sizes of $$A$$ and $$B$$ . Find the numbers in the positions $$a_{12}$$ , $$a_{31}$$ , $$b_{14}$$ , and $$b_{23}$$ . Use the appropriate letters with subscripts to describe all the locations of the number $$2$$ .

Describe the sizes of $$C$$ and $$D$$ . Find the numbers in the positions $$c_{14}$$ , $$c_{32}$$ , $$d_{13}$$ , and $$d_{22}$$ . Use the appropriate letters with subscripts to describe all the locations of the number $$3$$ .
